trajectory.continuity: Polynomial positions and derivatives continuous throughout forward1→6 motion; zero velocity at forward endpoints. Six PNGs sample the proposal; they contain no executable animation or interpolation.

continuous_nonoverlap.method: Analytical separating-axis proof for all66 pairs over every s∈[0,1], not merely sampled frames.
